description.en: An airy grey page with a soft white card, large rounded fields, a segmented control for the sign-in methods and a tall button, with the system font of the visitor's device. CSS only, so organization admins can install it.

theme.json.formCss:
<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: light;
  --background: 240 11% 96%;
  --foreground: 240 3% 12%;
  --card: 0 0% 100%;
  --card-foreground: 240 3% 12%;
  --muted: 240 6% 92%;
  --muted-foreground: 240 2% 44%;
  --accent: 240 6% 94%;
  --accent-foreground: 240 3% 12%;
  --border: 240 5% 84%;
  --input: 240 5% 84%;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
.login-background {
  background: #f5f5f7;
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 420px;
}
.login-panel {
  padding: 44px 40px 16px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}
.login-logo-box {
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.login-logo-box img {
  max-height: 64px;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  height: 36px;
  padding: 2px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: #e8e8ed;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12), 0 3px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04) !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #6e6e73;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 52px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border: 1px solid #d2d2d7;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #ffffff;
  font-size: 17px;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 22%, transparent);
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border-color: #86868b;
  border-radius: 5px;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
}
.login-form a {
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-weight: 400;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 400;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  opacity: 0.88;
}
#footer {
  color: #86868b;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
